subject.title: fix(eval): preserve OpenClaw and Hermes trajectories

question: Should the project accept these new OpenClaw/Hermes trajectory and benchmark-eligibility rules after live evidence confirms both fresh-run and recovered-run archival behavior on the intended stacked base?
rationale: Synthetic conversion tests establish parser expectations but cannot prove that the real harnesses emit, archive, select, and recover the intended session files in the privileged remote runner environment.

options.title: Request live benchmark evidence
options.body: Keep the PR open and require redacted fresh-run and recovery artifacts for OpenClaw and Hermes before approving the audit-eligibility change.

options.title: Approve the controlled environment assumption
options.body: Accept the runner’s sudo and session-layout assumptions based on existing infrastructure knowledge, while documenting that the next benchmark rerun is the operational validation.

recommendation.title: Request live benchmark evidence
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open and require redacted fresh-run and recovery artifacts for OpenClaw and Hermes before approving the audit-eligibility change.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history places this contributor closest to the stacked native evaluation implementation and its proposed live validation.
